rv.q: Published: 20:26 EDT, 3 August 2017 | Updated: 20:31 EDT, 3 August 2017. Good grief, what has Stockard Channing done to her face? The septuagenarian American has arrived at London's Trafalgar Studios for a four-month starring role in a play about an embittered old Sixties radical.

Among the personal possessions I've accumulated during many years of theatregoing, is a programme signed for me by Stockard Channing at the stage door of the Comedy Theatre in 1991. Back then, she was garnering plaudits for her turn as empathically naïve Ouisa Kittredge in Six Degrees of Separation.
